description: Antennes Télécom is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Evry-Courcouronnes. Mobile Frequency Observatory on Grand Paris Sud By communiqué of 9 October 2012, the Ministers Arnaud Montebourg and Fleur Pellerin wanted to make the deployment process of operators more transparent by setting up an observatory for investments and deployments in mobile networks. Coverage: Ville d'Evry-Courcouronnes. The portal shows the English title as "Telecom antennas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Evry-Courcouronnes. Its keywords include sfr, bouygues-telecom, gsm, orange, azimut, telecommunications. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2018-09-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
